sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini
sources.evidence: The January 31, 2025 announcement explicitly releases o3-mini in ChatGPT and the API that day, following a December preview. It describes three reasoning-effort settings, function calling and structured outputs, and explicitly excludes vision.

sources.title: o3-mini model reference
sources.evidence: Current exact-model reference lists snapshot o3-mini-2025-01-31, text input/output, 200,000 context tokens, 100,000 maximum output tokens, reasoning and function calling. It identifies a small alternative to o3, marks the model shut down, and lists cached input pricing of $0.55 per million tokens.

sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card publication
sources.evidence: The official January 31 publication links the working o3-mini-system-card-feb10.pdf. This is the source of the PDF URL used below, rather than an assumed filename.

sources.title: OpenAI o3-mini System Card, February 10 revision
sources.evidence: Downloaded the full 37-page card. Sections 2 and 3 describe pretraining, reinforcement learning and the launched checkpoint versus the near-final checkpoint. The full-text parameter and architecture checks found no production total, active count, dense/MoE specification or layer count; mentions of final parameters do not give parameter counts.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
sources.evidence: Reviewed the later full card and exact o3-mini comparison columns, including the multilingual evaluation table. Those columns give performance measurements. Table 1 gives total and active counts only for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b; its MoE specification does not describe o3-mini.

sources.title: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
sources.evidence: Read training sections and the exact o3-mini results. Section 2.4 names o3-mini as receiving the RL safety reward signal. The report supplies no production o3-mini parameter count or architecture specification.

sources.title: Persona Features Control Emergent Misalignment
sources.evidence: The later interpretability paper studies o3-mini and a helpful-only variant in section 2.5. Its SAE analysis instead uses GPT-4o activations in section 3.1. The o3-mini training experiments and full-text size checks supply no production parameter count; SAE feature sizes and other models in related work cannot be transferred.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201, archived pre-GPT-5.6 recipe
sources.evidence: The explicit scope is models before GPT-5.6. Section 2.1 describes OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer layers, attention Q/K/V projections and reuse of cached keys and values. Together with exact o3-mini cached-input support, this supports only a qualified broad Transformer inference.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: The April 22, 2026 legacy-model notice states that access was shut down on October 23, 2026 and explicitly includes both o3-mini-2025-01-31 and the o3-mini alias.

sources.title: API changelog: January 31, 2025
sources.evidence: The dated January 31 entry independently records the launch of o3-mini and o3-mini-2025-01-31, describing science, math and coding tasks.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Section 9.1 reserves intellectual-property rights in the service and grants only limited service-use rights; section 3.3 restricts reverse engineering. Together with the exact hosted release, this supports the descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: All models: legacy and open-weight listings
sources.evidence: The current official catalog lists o3-mini among shut-down models and separately identifies gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as Apache-licensed open-weight releases.

sources.title: Models.dev o3-mini upstream record
sources.evidence: The upstream lead uses December 20, 2024 and family o-mini. Its date conflicts with the first-party January 31 public launch; it is a preview-announcement date. Context and capabilities are independently confirmed by primary documentation. This catalog supplies no size evidence.

name.note: Official release name and API identifier.

developer.note: First-party announcement and system-card authorship identify OpenAI.

family.note: Normalize to o3: the exact reference identifies o3-mini as a small model alternative to o3. This does not transfer sibling specifications.

release_date.note: Contemporaneous public ChatGPT/API launch, independently recorded in the API changelog. The upstream December 20, 2024 date refers to the preview announcement; the baseline January 31 correction is retained.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary model; the official release and current catalog provide service access rather than an open checkpoint distribution.

license.note: Descriptive classification of limited hosted-service rights; no named open-weight license is asserted.

parameters_b.note: No production total disclosed in the reviewed original card, later exact-model comparison tables, training research or interpretability paper. Do not infer size from cost, benchmark scores, mini naming or GPT-OSS counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count or routing structure disclosed for this exact model. GPT-OSS active counts and SAE feature counts describe different objects.

architecture.note: Qualified broad inference: exact-model cached-input support binds o3-mini to the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation of Transformer attention and KV reuse. This is not an exact architecture specification. Dense versus MoE, layer count and other topology remain undisclosed; interpretability results for GPT-4o are not transferred.

context_window.note: Last-documented context limit. The separate maximum output is 100,000 tokens. The reference is historical specification evidence, not proof of a working endpoint after shutdown.

modalities.note: Exact-model reference is text-only, consistent with the launch explicitly excluding vision. Service tools and file handling do not establish native image, audio or PDF modalities.

reasoning.note: Original card and training research establish chain-of-thought reasoning with reinforcement learning; the launch offers low, medium and high effort settings.

tool_call.note: Exact-model launch and reference both explicitly support function calling.

description.value: Text-only reasoning model with adjustable reasoning effort, function calling, and structured outputs.
description.note: Replace relative price and planning language with directly documented model behavior.

patch.description: Text-only reasoning model with adjustable reasoning effort, function calling, and structured outputs.
patch.notes: Released January 31, 2025 after a December 2024 preview. The o3-mini-2025-01-31 snapshot and alias were shut down on October 23, 2026. Last documented limits: 200,000 context tokens and 100,000 output tokens. Transformer is a broad inference from exact-model caching support and applicable OpenAI engineering documentation; detailed topology and total/active parameter counts are undisclosed. Low, medium and high are reasoning-effort settings.

summary: Confirmed the January 31, 2025 release, text-only modalities, 200,000-token context, reasoning and function calling. Corrected family to o3, added descriptive Proprietary licensing and a qualified broad Transformer classification, simplified the description, and documented exact-snapshot retirement. Counts remain undisclosed after the original system card, later comparison tables and training/interpretability research were checked.
